summary.text: Sylvia Taylor is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 57 (St. Charles and St. John the Baptist parishes), and was elected in 2023, according to the official House member page.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Sylvia Taylor's occupation as Attorney and Retired Judge.
It lists education as B.A., English Education, Dillard University; Southern University Law Center; J.D., Loyola University New Orleans College of Law.

The page lists committee assignments including Civil Law and Procedure, Education, Retirement and the House Select Committee on Women and Children, and caucus affiliations including the Acadiana Delegation, the Democratic Caucus, the Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus, the Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus and the Louisiana Rural Caucus.
